reasoning.agent_summary:
Actions taken:
- Identity confirmed under S2.1(a) via booking reference AER-3B7Y5K and surname match.
- Reviewed ops record: AK640 on 2026-08-01 was cancelled for TECHNICAL cause; passenger re-routed onto AK644 the same day; arrival delay at final destination LHR was 220 minutes (3h40). Passenger booked Business and flown Economy on the affected return segment S2.
- Executed payment via the entitlement calculation service (S10.2). Paid a total of £415.00 to passenger P1:
  - £175.00 statutory compensation (Band B, re-routed, arrival delay ≥3h but <5h → 50% reduction per S5.4).
  - £240.00 involuntary downgrade reimbursement (50% of segment S2 fare £480.00 per S9.1 and S9.4).
  - Payment reference: CMP-00014.

Passenger must be told:
- We have processed payment of £415.00 for Tomas Ferreira: £175.00 compensation and £240.00 downgrade reimbursement.
- The flight was cancelled due to a technical fault. Technical faults are within Aerlink’s control and are not extraordinary (S3.3, S3.4).
- Compensation is assessed on arrival delay at the final destination, not on departure delay (S5.2). Your arrival delay was 220 minutes (3h40). Because you were re-routed and arrived less than 5 hours late for a Band B journey, the compensation is reduced by 50% to £175.00 (S5.4). The Band B standard amount of £350.00 only applies where the re-routed arrival delay is 5 hours or more.
- Downgrade reimbursement is based on the fare for the affected segment only (S9.4), not the total booking price and not taxes or ancillaries. For your LIS→LHR segment (S2), 50% of the £480.00 segment fare is £240.00. This is paid in addition to any compensation (S9.3).
- Duty of care was owed on cancellation regardless of cause (S4.1, S4.3). If you incurred reasonable expenses, please provide itemised receipts for reimbursement up to the caps in S4.2:
  - Meals/refreshments: up to £30 per passenger per 6 hours;
  - Two calls or equivalent;
  - Hotel (if needed): up to £180 per room per night, max 3 nights (subject to availability);
  - Transport to/from accommodation: up to £45 per journey.
  Reimbursement is against receipts; amounts above these caps are not covered under S4 but can be reviewed separately under goodwill policy.
- Your requested total of £970.00 exceeds the amount owed under the policy because:
  - Compensation is reduced by 50% due to the re-routed arrival delay being under 5 hours (S5.4).
  - Downgrade reimbursement is 50% of the affected segment fare (£480.00), not 50% of the full booking total (S9.4).

Awaiting passenger decision:
- None.

Uncertainties:
- None.
